rounds.prompt: How many standard 2x4 LEGO bricks would it take to build a solid, full-size copy of the Great Sphinx of Giza?
rounds.source: Encyclopaedia Britannica (73 m long, 20 m high) · Wikipedia (19 m wide at the haunches) · LEGO's 8 mm stud, 9.6 mm brick grid

rounds.prompt: How many cities in the world are home to 1 million people or more, counting each city and its suburbs as one place?
rounds.source: citypopulation.de (Thomas Brinkhoff), Major Agglomerations of the World, 1 January 2026: 652 urban agglomerations of 1 million or more · cross-check: UN World Urbanization Prospects 2018 (548 in 2018, projected 706 by 2030)

rounds.prompt: About how many sesame seeds are on the top of a Big Mac bun?
rounds.source: Harper's Index: 178 sesame seeds on the average Big Mac bun
